description: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory publishes Buildings Sector Scenarios for United States energy planning through 2050. The own OpenEI page links public scenario data, an object registry and a README under CC BY 4.0. The article abstract describes county-level hourly electricity demand and state-level annual non-electric fuel projections by building sector and end use. Public access is free. These paths can inform electricity expansion and building electrification simulations with model-energyplus as a related building-level context. Coverage is the contiguous United States and the published benchmark assumptions, not a prediction of one certain future. A caveat is that technology adoption, stock turnover and efficiency choices drive scenario differences; users must not combine incompatible scenario years or geographies. The own provider page and public metadata were read without fetching bulk S3 objects or checking every internal format. The dataset is distinct from the earlier LBNL 2023 scenario website.
